criterion_reasons.MATCH-OUT-OF-PLAY-DETECT: PASS on every boundary-carrying run: boundary events carry well-formed payloads and goal / goal-line out-of-play are mutually exclusive.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-OUT-OF-PLAY-NO-LAST-TOUCH: PASS where a no-last-touch boundary was observed (rules-throwin-baseline, rules-throw-in-live): every such boundary opened no restart. NOT_EVALUATED where every boundary had a resolvable last touch.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-KICKOFF-FREEZE: PASS where a clean multi-body untouched opening window was observed (throw-in and arc runs): only the designated taker + any at-ball body left home. NOT_EVALUATED where the window is absent / single-body (rules-corner-baseline).
criterion_reasons.MATCH-SCORING-GOAL-DEVENT: PASS on every goal-carrying run: every goal event carries a valid goalIndex and is mutually exclusive with goal-line out-of-play.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-THROW-IN-AWARD: PASS on the driven throw-in stream (rules-throw-in-live, 2 executed throw-ins): each served throw-in went to the team opposite the last-touch team. NOT_EVALUATED on the non-serialized baseline (the throw-in-executed event is not in the standard stream).
criterion_reasons.MATCH-GOAL-KICK-AWARD: PASS on the driven goal-kick stream (rules-goal-kick-live, 1 executed goal kick): the goal kick was awarded to the defending team of the exited goal line. NOT_EVALUATED on the non-serialized baseline.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-TIMER-FREEZE: PASS on the driven streams (rules-throw-in-live, rules-goal-kick-live): the core matchTimer is frozen during the non-playing restart / goal phases. NOT_EVALUATED on the non-serialized baseline (core matchPhase/matchTimer not in the standard stream).
criterion_reasons.MATCH-CORNER-KICK-AWARD: NOT_EVALUATED: no driven or organic run produced a corner-kick execution (a defending-team last-touch over its own goal line is rare in this engine). Not forced to PASS.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-THROW-IN-PLACEMENT / MATCH-THROW-I: NOT_EVALUATED — no oracle yet for the placement / serve / restart-specific timer-freeze semantics.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-GOAL-KICK-PLACEMENT / MATCH-GOAL-K: NOT_EVALUATED — no oracle yet for the goal-kick placement / restart-specific timer-freeze semantics.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-CORNER-KICK-PLACEMENT / MATCH-CORN: NOT_EVALUATED — no oracle yet for the corner placement / restart-specific timer-freeze semantics.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-KICKOFF-FIRST-TOUCH / MATCH-RESTAR: NOT_EVALUATED — no oracle yet for the first-touch / restart-rearm semantics.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-SCORING-GOAL-PHASE: NOT_EVALUATED — no oracle yet for the playing → goal → playing phase transition.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-TIMER-DECREMENT / MATCH-TIMER-HALF: NOT_EVALUATED — no oracle yet for the decrement / halftime / fulltime semantics.
criterion_reasons.MATCH-RESTART-FREEZE-UNTIL-FIRST-TOUCH /: NOT_EVALUATED — no oracle yet for the anti-huddle freeze / nearest-only semantics.
